dct_description_sm: Information on the ESC survey is available from the York University Institute for Social Research  http://www.isr.yorku.ca/.

Equality, Security and Community Survey is a national study exploring the economic, social and political factors that shape public policy, and how these policies determine societal values, attitudes and well-being among individuals and communities. The first wave of the Equality Security Community Survey was conducted in 1999-2000. It is a nationally-representative telephone survey combining questions on labour economics, social capital, associational memberships, and policy preferences.
